allow: PowerShell($port = new-Object System.IO.Ports.SerialPort COM8,115200,None,8,one; $port.ReadTimeout = 1000; $port.DtrEnable = $true; $port.RtsEnable = $true; $port.Open\(\); Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200; $port.DtrEnable = $false; $port.RtsEnable = $false; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; $port.DtrEnable = $true; $port.RtsEnable = $true; $start = Get-Date; while \(\(\(Get-Date\) - $start\).TotalSeconds -lt 12\) { try { $line = $port.ReadLine\(\); Write-Host $line } catch [TimeoutException] { } }; $port.Close\(\))
